title: Understanding the rise of China | Martin Jacques
summary: Economist Martin Jacques offers three building blocks for understanding China's rise, including seeing China as a civilization-state rather than a nation-state. He also covers how Chinese people view the state.
why: HN recommends it in discussions of China's surveillance and social-credit systems for explaining Chinese attitudes toward the state.

quote.text: I highly recommend Martin Jacques' Ted talk [0] on this very subject from over 7 years ago.
